title: Carryover Gap Scrub — Aug 2027 (Ad-hoc cross-functional tally)
content:
SUMMARY:
This is a quick, one-off scrub of items carried over into the Aug 4–18 ops window that are blocking cross-team deliverables. Purpose is to produce a short prioritized handoff list for engineering, SRE, and product partners; identify trivial items we can close in one pass; and surface anything that needs an escalation path.

SHEET VIEW (columns: id | item | current_owner | impact | est_effort | blocker | next_action | target_by | notes)
1 | billing quota delta on hosted API | Finance/RevOps (Priya) | Medium (billing alerts, customer-facing) | 1 day | missing API usage mapping | assign to engineering for mapping; quick SL query | 2027-08-18 | several customers hit overage this week; draft customer note ready
2 | dev sandbox infra flakiness | Eng infra (Liam) | High (blocks SE demos) | 2 days | flaky infra-provision job | run reproducible incident + revert recent infra template change | 2027-08-16 | next deploy window 08-15; try hotfix before then
3 | rollout failover mapping for EU region | SRE (Marta) | High (latency/regional fallback) | 3 days | missing routing table for fallback | create patch routing table + smoke tests | 2027-08-20 | ties to dedicated capacity workstream
4 | shared doc taxonomy mismatch | Product (Asha) | Low (confusing links) | 3 hours | no blocker | consolidate doc index + update links | 2027-08-13 | quick win, do in this scrub
5 | function-calling schema mismatch in sample apps | DevX (Diego) | Medium | 1 day | open PR with tests failing | pair with author to fix tests | 2027-08-17 | affects quickstart templates used in sales demos
6 | embeddings cost spikes on customer staging | Infra/Optimize | Medium (cost) | 1 day | missing cache config | enable short-term cache + monitor | 2027-08-16 | preflight to avoid billing impact in Aug billing run
7 | private deployment onboarding doc gaps | Solutions Eng | Low | 4 hours | missing TLS examples | add TLS section + code snippets | 2027-08-15 | blocked deals for two POCs, needs ASAP
8 | canary rollout metric mismatch | Console team | Medium | 1 day | metric name mismatch in telemetry | coordinate metrics rename + backfill mapping | 2027-08-18 | affects rollout dashboards
9 | partner SLA exception wording | Legal/Account Mgmt | Low | 2 hours | legal review needed | legal to supply approved language | 2027-08-19 | customer asks for explicit wording change
10 | one-off capacity bump for hackathon | Product Ops | Low | 1 day | budget signoff | get signoff from finance | 2027-08-14 | hackathon on 08-19, small GPU pool needed

QUICK METRICS SNAPSHOT:
- Total rows: 10
- High impact items: 2 (rows 2,3)
- Quick wins (<= half day): 4 (rows 4,7,9,10)
- Requires cross-team coordination (>=2 teams): 5 (rows 1,2,3,5,8)

PRIORITY RECOMMENDATION (short):
1) Triage high-impact infra / SRE items (rows 2 & 3) — assign on-call SRE + infra lead, escalate to Eng director if not started by EOD 2027-08-13.
2) Close quick wins in this scrub (rows 4,7,9,10) — owners to mark done and update doc index by 2027-08-14.
3) Schedule pairing sessions for sample apps / PR fixes (row 5) — Diego to pair with author, tag GH-PR-4521.
4) Medium priority: billing mapping & embeddings cache (rows 1,6) — RevOps + Eng to coordinate a stable mapping and short-term cache before billing run.
5) Canary metrics and rollout mapping (rows 8) — console + telemetry to coordinate, add a canary smoke test.

ACTION ITEMS ASSIGNED (fast checklist):
- Priya: Share current billing SL query and customer list (due 08-13).
- Liam: Reproduce infra provisioning failure and propose rollback (due 08-15).
- Marta: Prepare EU routing table patch and smoke tests (due 08-18).
- Diego: Fix failing tests on sample apps and merge PR (due 08-17).
- Asha: Consolidate doc index and publish redirect doc (done 08-13).
- Finance: Approve hackathon capacity budget (due 08-14).

NOTES TO SELF / SCRUB LOG: 
- 08-12 09:15: initial pass and owner assignments (Asha)
- 08-13 10:02: Priya uploaded customer list to linked Confluence page
- 08-13 16:40: Quick doc index consolidation completed; shared in #docs-review
- 08-14 08:20: Liam posted repro steps to GH issue; triage call scheduled 08-14 11:00

OPEN QUESTIONS / UNCERTAINTIES: 
- Billing mapping: do we need a permanent metric or just a short-term alias? (Priya/Eng decision)
- EU routing fallback: do we use regional model variant or traffic steering? (SRE/Serving-runtime)
- Cost of short cache for embeddings: how much to approve for staging? (Optimize + Finance)

ESCALATION PATHS: 
- If infra repro not started by 2027-08-14 11:00 — escalate to Eng VP (Carlos Mendes).
- If customer-impacting billing issues remain after 08-18 — Customer Success to prepare holding message and Legal to review.

ATTACHMENTS / REFERENCES: 
- link: https://confluence.company/x/Carryover-Notes-2027
- GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1120
- JIRA: JIRA-ENG-9842

END OF SCRUB.

(This document is intentionally lightweight — use it as a short-lived operational artifact. Move resolved rows into the canonical backlog tickets and update the doc index.)
